scope: R196: the per-tile serialisation is located - a single Sij buffer blocks the intended prefetch

loop_structure.inner: for kv_blk_idx over 144 k blocks, with if_scope skipping non-causal blocks for this q block

per_tile_step_order.what: Sij += attn_mask on the diagonal block only
load K(j+1) then Sij = Qi x K(j+1).T
per_tile_step_order.buffer: WRITES Sij_ub_zN - the same buffer as step 3

smoking_gun.observation: step 4 passes workspace=Sij_ub_zN, writing back into the buffer softmax in step 3 just read
smoking_gun.consequence: a read-after-write / write-after-read dependency forces softmax to finish completely before the next matmul can start writing
smoking_gun.why_it_matters: softmax (vector) and matmul (cube) are precisely the pair that should overlap; single buffering makes overlap impossible and costs one cube-vector round trip per tile
smoking_gun.matches_r193: consistent in both magnitude and mechanism with the measured 2.922 us per-tile fixed cost

fix.name: Sij ping-pong double buffering
fix.design: two alternating UB buffers; softmax reads buf[j%2] while matmul(j+1) writes buf[(j+1)%2], removing the conflict
fix.chosen_config: Bc=256, which divides 43776 and gives 29412 tiles
fix.note: Bc=256 on its own measured slower than Bc=304 (169.94 vs 154.57 ms, 0.910x), so the double buffering has to more than offset that

projected_payoff_at_bc256.conclusion: removing 80 percent of the overhead already clears the 1.50x the 10 s target needs

secondary_finding.observation: the outer loop runs range(Tc-1) and skips non-causal blocks at runtime through if_scope rather than trimming the loop bound per q block
secondary_finding.potential: could save some of the guard work across 828 waves

limits: source reading only, not implementation and not measurement; every payoff figure above is an estimate
whether TIK synchronisation semantics actually allow overlap inside one new_stmt_scope still has to be verified in tik_ops_utils before implementing
compiling the Bc=256 double-buffered variant is unverified
retiling changes accumulation order, so any variant is numerically non-equivalent and must be measured only, never adopted without approval
